title: Current baseline, no new overrides
why: Clears the managed ETW wave block and captures the current tuned config as control.
judgeBy: Use clean 5s-40s P99/P95/max, game CPU cores, SimulationTicks, and top CPU modules.

title: Particle cull threshold default-ish comparison
why: Tests whether current 999 is hurting P99. 1200 is the public default used in older/public Source 2 references.
risk: May increase CPU culling versus 999 but may reduce extra GPU draw.
judgeBy: Keep only if clean P99/P95 improves or stays flat while CPU modules do not worsen.

title: Particle cull threshold prior live comparison
why: Restores the earlier live value for a 999 vs 1200 vs 1600 triangle test.
risk: More large particle systems may spend CPU on culling.
judgeBy: Reject if worker-pool particle/scene CPU samples rise or clean P99 worsens.

title: Temporary entity collision limit sanity test
why: Current live value 999999 is extreme. Sqooky uses 1000; current public default is 5. This targets vphysics2/main-thread cost without jumping straight to 5.
risk: Temp-entity collision behavior is not well documented. Watch tracers, impacts, projectile effects, and hit readability.
judgeBy: Keep only if vphysics2/main-thread CPU and clean P99 improve with no gameplay visual problems.

title: Breakable prop piece cap zero
why: Current live value is 0.5 and public default is 16. Sqooky uses 0. This may reduce breakable-prop spike work.
risk: Could change breakable debris visuals. Likely low gameplay risk.
judgeBy: Look for lower spike max/P99 in fights or minion/object break situations.

title: Particle updates on render-only frames
why: Missing locally, current dump default is false, and the name suggests fewer particle update gaps on render-only frames. This is weak-docs but directly targets particle timing.
risk: Particle timing/readability can change. Watch ultimates and lingering area effects.
judgeBy: Keep only if particle/scene CPU or P99 improves and visuals stay correct.

title: Disable positional UI audio
why: Live has 1 while OptimizationLock uses false. Only test this if AudioMixer/soundsystem becomes visible in ETW.
risk: UI sound positioning may feel different.
judgeBy: Keep only if AudioMixer/soundsystem CPU drops without hurting usability.

title: Disable audio occlusion rays
why: Missing locally; OptimizationLock uses 0 and public references show default 4. Deprioritized until audio is a bottleneck.
judgeBy: Only keep if AudioMixer/soundsystem is a top ETW bucket and this lowers it.

title: Thread pool option 6 comparison
why: Current measured-good value is 4. This tests whether 6 improves worker scheduling and 1% lows.
risk: Unknown mapping. Reject immediately if clean P99/max or input feel worsens.
judgeBy: Compare GlobPool balance, MainThrd CPU, ReadyThread/CSwitch pressure, clean P99, and clean max.

title: Particle cull threshold aggressive GPU-headroom test
why: More aggressive than 999. May skip CPU culling for more large particle systems while spending more GPU headroom.
risk: Can increase GPU overdraw or present time. Verify VConsole stickiness because this cvar is not in the current public Deadlock dump.
judgeBy: Keep only if particle CPU drops and amdxx64/D3D/present metrics do not rise meaningfully.

title: Texture pool 512 hitch test
why: Not a direct CPU cut. Tests whether a larger pool reduces material/texture streaming churn and lows.
risk: Uses more VRAM and may reduce max-FPS purity on low VRAM. Only useful if texture pop-in or traversal hitches are seen.
judgeBy: Keep only if material/render clean P99 or max improves during traversal/fights without VRAM pressure.
